function.name: get_tools
function.description: Get a different set of tools.

oneOf.description: View user screen, web search, weather forecast, wiki search and other basic tools.
Control desktop applications, performs UI actions, clicks, and types to open apps, navigate for user.
Create, write, modify, delete files and directories.
Read, list or search for different types of files- images, pdf, docx, csv, txt, log etc.
Understand, edit, search, or diagnose source code and Jupyter notebook cells. Not for ordinary file or directory housekeeping.

function.name: update_system_memory
function.description: Regenerate the memory profile entirely. Use when user explicitly states to 'remember','forget' or similar.

memory.description: Markdown formatted memory text to rewrite. Follow the previous system memory format.

function.name: update_scratchpad
function.description: Write down your plan, track sub-tasks, save code snippets, or whatever you want. Use this to remember what you are doing across turns. This tool overwrites the old scratchpad.

notes.description: The complete, updated text of your scratchpad notes.

function.name: clear_context
function.description: Clear context, only use when context limit warning is triggered. WARNING: This tool deletes the entire chat (except system memory), so leave a full explanation for next agent to continue. Use the next agent can only read- `message` argument, scratchpad notes and system memory.

message.description: A fully detailed message explaining the situation and tasks pending(if any) to pass on to the next agent.
